description: This file implements AES encryption and decryption functionalities, including key setup and various cipher modes, using mbedtls library functions within the Thunder::Crypto namespace.

classes.name: AESEncryption
classes.description: Class providing AES encryption functionalities with support for multiple cipher modes.

classes.name: AESDecryption
classes.description: Class providing AES decryption functionalities with support for multiple cipher modes.

methods.name: AESEncryption::Key
methods.description: Sets the encryption key for AES encryption, supporting 128, 192, and 256-bit keys.

methods.name: AESEncryption::Encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES encryption on input data using the specified mode (ECB, CBC, CFB8, CFB128, OFB).

methods.name: AESDecryption::Key
methods.description: Sets the decryption key for AES decryption, supporting 128, 192, and 256-bit keys.

methods.name: AESDecryption::Decrypt
methods.description: Performs AES decryption on input data using the specified mode (ECB, CBC, CFB8, CFB128, OFB).
